discussion_summary: Session 1 isolated JWT verification failure in dependencies.py as root cause of 401 errors. Session 2 created investor demo script documenting full UX flow. This session fixed three blocking bugs: (1) investor.py queried non-existent `applications` table instead of `startup_applications`, (2) empty audio blobs from accidental mic taps crashed Whisper with unhandled 400/500 errors, (3) Stage1Client.tsx had no navigation logic to transition to stage2 when user asked to open a specific project. Added `navigation_target` to Jev responses, suppressed workspace fetching when projects are clearly requested, and implemented fuzzy matching + navigation intent handling in Stage1Client. User reports stage1 now shows projects-only list and can navigate to stage2, but navigation is still not working reliably — fuzzy matching may be missing project names or the navigation_target field is not being populated correctly by Jev.

accomplishments.what: Fixed table name in investor.py: changed `FROM applications` to `FROM startup_applications` to match actual migration schema
Added error handling in audio.py extractors: catch OpenAI Whisper errors and return empty string instead of propagating 500
Added frontend minimum blob size guard (1000 bytes) in Stage1Client, Stage2Client, and AdminConversationClient before sending audio to Whisper
Extended Jev prompt in investor.py to include `navigation_target` field for intent-based navigation (e.g., 'open_project', 'show_projects')
Modified investor.py stage1 endpoint to suppress workspace fetching when `is_asking_projects > 0.7` probability
Implemented navigation logic in Stage1Client.tsx: check for `navigate` intent, fuzzy-match project names, call router.push() to stage2 before re-querying API

Created 8 task cards for remaining frontend/backend work (investor router, activities endpoint, API methods, layout, PillNav, ActivityDrawer, root redirect, investor/admin pages) and marked all as completed
